scope: pure stdlib controls and frozen metadata only, no Torch/GPU/fixture tensor/candidate

checks.name: wrong_gate_block
problems: gate reviewed_scope.block 'calibration' does not authorize block 'evaluation'

checks.name: candidate_negatives_nonzero
problems: negative mutations are calibration-only: held-out requires --negatives 0 and reviewed_scope.negatives 0

checks.name: gate_negatives_nonzero
problems: negative mutations are calibration-only: held-out requires --negatives 0 and reviewed_scope.negatives 0

checks.name: candidate_limit_partial
problems: held-out requires complete coverage: --limit must be 0

checks.name: gate_missing_fixture
problems: gate reviewed_scope.held_out_fixture_ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random'] does not name exactly the manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']

checks.name: gate_duplicate_fixture
problems: gate reviewed_scope.held_out_fixture_ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress', 'evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random'] does not name exactly the manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']

checks.name: manifest_missing_fixture
problems: policy domain evaluation_held_out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress'] != manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']
gate reviewed_scope.held_out_fixture_ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress'] does not name exactly the manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']

checks.name: manifest_duplicate_fixture
problems: manifest has no complete typed unique fixture set for block 'evaluation': ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress', 'evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random']

policy domain evaluation_held_out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress'] != manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']

gate reviewed_scope.held_out_fixture_ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress'] does not name exactly the manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']

checks.name: policy_missing_fixture
problems: policy domain evaluation_held_out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random'] != manifest held-out ids ['evaluation/fx0_ordinary-random', 'evaluation/fx1_mixed-stress']

checks.name: wrong_runner_sha
problems: held-out gate does not bind this runner's bytes

checks.name: missing_power_run
problems: gate reviewed_scope.calibration_power_run_id must name the accepted calibration run (negative power source)

checks.name: empty_power_run
problems: gate reviewed_scope.calibration_power_run_id must name the accepted calibration run (negative power source)

parent_power_authority_condition: Parent must bind/copy/verify accepted calibration summary, terminal receipt and acceptance receipt in the trusted held-out gate; runner alone checks only a nonempty run ID.
